py-kits

Python tools for Location Uncertainty in NEMO: read ocean data, operate on ORCA grids, estimate the statistics and structure of the stochastic noise, reduce records to a few modes, and diagnose the results.

Each kit below has a page saying why it exists and what it holds; each routine has a page with what it does and why, its formula, an example from the tests, where the library uses it, and the NEMO lines it follows (searched in NEMO 5.0.2, 4.2.2, newest first).

datakitRead the ocean reanalyses, and the fields computed from them, all in the same way. 6 modules, 39 functions
orcakitOperations on NEMO's ORCA grids: the C-grid stencils, the seam and fold, masks, filters and parallel tiles. 7 modules, 78 functions
noisekitStatistics and structure of the stochastic noise of Location Uncertainty, from ocean data. 13 modules, 72 functions
modredkitModel reduction: the decompositions that turn a long record of fields into a few patterns. 3 modules, 41 functions
diagkitDiagnostics of model output and of data: metrics, flow quantities, statistics, spectra and maps. 6 modules, 26 functions
gyrekitWhat is specific to the GYRE configurations (R3, R9, R27): runs, masks and coarse-graining. 3 modules, 9 functions

py-kits

datakit

Read the ocean reanalyses, and the fields computed from them, all in the same way.

The datasets this library works from (GLORYS04 daily, GLORYS12 and the CMEMS ORAS5 reanalysis monthly) differ in file layout, variable names, time units and grids. datakit hides those differences: every dataset, raw or derived, is a Source with the same functions, returns arrays of the same shape with land as NaN, and gives its grid, masks and cell thicknesses on request. Results are written back in one file convention, with their history, so they read like a raw dataset and can feed the next step.

Data locations come from paths.toml (orcakit.paths), so the same code runs on any machine.

Conventions: arrays are float32, land is NaN, and north is at the high y index, with no flip; only plotting may flip. Time is axis 0, then depth, then y and x. Fields can be asked for by common name (u, v, w, ssh, sst, temp, ubt, vbt) or by NEMO's name.

Example:

from datakit import source, derived, clean

src = source("glorys04")
ssh = src.read("ssh", "2015-01", "2015-03")                     # (nt, ny, nx)
u3d = src.read("u", "2015-01-01", "2015-01-01", level=None)     # (1, nz, ny, nx)
box = source("glorys12").read("ssh", box=(1500, 1800, 1000, 1400))
e1t, e2t = src.mesh("e1t", "e2t")
e3u, e3v, umask, vmask = src.vertical()

for date, u, v in src.stream("u", "v", start="2015-01", end="2015-02"):
    u = clean(u)                                                # one snapshot at a time

groups, missing = src.groups("u", "v", start="2015")            # (date, u file, v file)
split = derived("/path/to/out/split", src)                      # data written with write_field

Modules

_sourceSource, the description of a dataset; source() opens a raw one, derived() a computed one
_readfinding files by variable and date, and reading snapshots, records and mesh fields
_writewrite_field, the common file convention, and provenance and history attributes
glorys04GLORYS2V4, 1/4 degree, daily, 2015-2016
glorys12GLORYS12V1, 1/12 degree, monthly
cmemsORAS5 from CMEMS, 1/4 degree, monthly

py-kits › datakit › _read › file_date

file_date

The date written in a file name.

Description

Files of every dataset carry their date in the name, daily or monthly, in a few spellings. This reads it in one form, so files of different variables can be matched by date.

Recognises _YYYY-MM-DD, _YYYY-MM and _YYYYMM before an underscore or .nc.

$$\text{date} = \texttt{YYYY-MM-DD} \text{ or } \texttt{YYYY-MM} \text{ from } \texttt{\_YYYY[-]MM[-DD]} \text{ in the name}$$

Syntax

date = file_date(path)

Input Arguments

path — str
File path; the name holds _YYYY-MM-DD, _YYYY-MM or _YYYYMM

Output Arguments

date — str
'YYYY-MM-DD' for daily files, 'YYYY-MM' for monthly ones

Example

ok("daily date", ["x_2015-03-07.nc" in "x_2015-03-07.nc", R.file_date("a/x_2015-03-07.nc") == "2015-03-07"], 1); yes("daily", R.file_date("a/x_2015-03-07.nc") == "2015-03-07"); yes("monthly", R.file_date("x_2015-03.nc") == "2015-03"); yes("compact", R.file_date("x_201503.nc") == "2015-03")
Whole test
with test("datakit._read.file_date", "datakit._read.find_files", "datakit._read.clean", "datakit._read.read_one", "datakit._read.stream_files", "datakit._read.read_stack", "datakit._read.read_mesh"):
    ok("daily date", ["x_2015-03-07.nc" in "x_2015-03-07.nc", R.file_date("a/x_2015-03-07.nc") == "2015-03-07"], 1); yes("daily", R.file_date("a/x_2015-03-07.nc") == "2015-03-07"); yes("monthly", R.file_date("x_2015-03.nc") == "2015-03"); yes("compact", R.file_date("x_201503.nc") == "2015-03")
    root = os.path.join(TMP, "arch")
    for v, sc in (("uu", 1.), ("vv", 2.)):
        for d in (1, 2, 3):
            a = np.ma.array(sc*d*np.ones((1, 3, 4, 5)), mask=False); a[0, :, 0, 0] = np.ma.masked
            p = os.path.join(root, v); os.makedirs(p, exist_ok=True)
            with netCDF4.Dataset(os.path.join(p, f"{v}_2015-01-0{d}.nc"), "w") as nc:
                for dn, s in (("time_counter", 1), ("depthu", 3), ("y", 4), ("x", 5)): nc.createDimension(dn, s)
                nc.createVariable(v, "f4", ("time_counter", "depthu", "y", "x"), fill_value=1e20)[...] = a
    fl = R.find_files(root, "uu", "2015-01-02", "2015-01-03"); yes("dates inclusive", len(fl) == 2)
    yes("month filter", len(R.find_files(root, "uu", "2015-01", "2015-01")) == 3)
    ok("clean", np.nan_to_num(R.clean(np.array([1., 11., np.nan, -3.]), 10., -9)) - [1, -9, -9, -3], 0)
    s = R.read_stack(fl, "uu", level=1, box=(1, 3, 2, 5)); yes("level and box", s.shape == (2, 2, 3)); ok("value", s[1] - 3, 0)
    s = R.read_stack(fl, "uu", level=None); yes("all levels", s.shape == (2, 3, 4, 5)); yes("land NaN", np.isnan(s[0, 0, 0, 0]))
    it = list(R.stream_files([fl, R.find_files(root, "vv", "2015-01-02", "2015-01-03")], ("uu", "vv"))); ok("stream ratio", it[0][2][2, 2]/it[0][1][2, 2] - 2, 0); yes("stream date", it[0][0] == "2015-01-02")
    try: list(R.stream_files([fl, R.find_files(root, "vv", "2015-01-01", "2015-01-02")], ("uu", "vv"))); yes("mismatch refused", False)
    except ValueError: yes("mismatch refused", True)
    mp = ncfile("mesh.nc", dict(t=1, y=2, x=2), e1t=(("t", "y", "x"), np.ones((1, 2, 2)))); ok("mesh squeezed", R.read_mesh([mp], "e1t").shape[0] - 2, 0)

py-kits › datakit › _read › find_files

find_files

The files of one variable in a dataset folder, between two dates.

Description

Every dataset stores one file per variable and date under <root>/<var>/. This lists those of one variable in date order, accepting common names such as u or ssh as well as NEMO's, and a barotropic name, whose values sit in the file of the full-depth variable.

Dates compare on their common length, so '2015' selects a whole year of daily or monthly files. Raises FileNotFoundError if the folder holds none.

$$\{\, f \in \text{root}/v/v\_*.nc \ :\ \text{start} \le \text{date}(f) \le \text{end} \,\}, \text{ sorted by date}$$

Syntax

files = find_files(root, var)files = find_files(root, var, start=None, end=None)

Input Arguments

root — str
Dataset folder
var — str
Common or NEMO name of the variable
start — str — default None
First date, inclusive, or None for no limit
end — str — default None
Last date, inclusive, or None for no limit

Output Arguments

files — list
Paths sorted by date. Raises FileNotFoundError if the folder has none

Example

fl = R.find_files(root, "uu", "2015-01-02", "2015-01-03"); yes("dates inclusive", len(fl) == 2)
yes("month filter", len(R.find_files(root, "uu", "2015-01", "2015-01")) == 3)
it = list(R.stream_files([fl, R.find_files(root, "vv", "2015-01-02", "2015-01-03")], ("uu", "vv"))); ok("stream ratio", it[0][2][2, 2]/it[0][1][2, 2] - 2, 0); yes("stream date", it[0][0] == "2015-01-02")
try: list(R.stream_files([fl, R.find_files(root, "vv", "2015-01-01", "2015-01-02")], ("uu", "vv"))); yes("mismatch refused", False)
Whole test

py-kits › datakit › _read › clean

clean

Mark unusable values, such as fill values left in raw files.

Description

Raw files sometimes keep a huge fill value, or infinities, where a NaN was meant. Any value that is not finite or larger than limit in size is replaced, by NaN unless another fill is asked for.

$$\text{clean}(x) = x \text{ if } |x| \le \text{limit}, \text{ else fill}$$

Syntax

field_out = clean(field)field_out = clean(field, limit=10.0, fill=np.nan)

Input Arguments

field — float
Array of any shape
limit — float — default 10.0
Largest absolute value kept
fill — float — default np.nan
Value put in place of the others, NaN by default

Output Arguments

field_out — float
field, with non-finite values and values beyond limit replaced by fill

Example

ok("clean", np.nan_to_num(R.clean(np.array([1., 11., np.nan, -3.]), 10., -9)) - [1, -9, -9, -3], 0)

py-kits › datakit › _read › read_one

read_one

One snapshot of a variable from one file.

Description

The datasets differ in how they lay out a file: with or without a time axis, and with depth called deptht, depthu, depthv or depthw. This reads any of them into the same shape, land as NaN, with one level or a box of grid points if asked.

The time axis, if any, is reduced to its first entry.

$$x = \text{file}[v][t{=}0,\ \text{level},\ j_0{:}j_1,\ i_0{:}i_1],\ \text{masked} \to \text{NaN}$$

Syntax

field = read_one(path, var)field = read_one(path, var, level=None, box=None, dtype=np.float32)

Input Arguments

path — str
NetCDF file
var — str
Common or NEMO name of the variable
level — int — default None
One level, or None for all levels; ignored for 2D fields
box — tuple — default None
(j0, j1, i0, i1) index box, or None for the whole grid
dtype — dtype — default np.float32
Type of the result

Output Arguments

field — float
(ny, nx) or (nz, ny, nx), with masked points (land, fill) as NaN

Example

py-kits › datakit › _read › stream_files

stream_files

Read several variables snapshot by snapshot, checking their dates match.

Description

Long records do not fit in memory; reading one date at a time does. The variables are read together so each step gets, for example, u and v of the same day.

Raises ValueError if the lists differ in length or a step's files differ in date.

$$(d, x_1, \dots, x_n) \text{ for each date } d, \text{ with } \text{date}(f_k) = d \text{ for every variable } k$$

Syntax

stream_files(file_lists, names)stream_files(file_lists, names, level=0, box=None)

Input Arguments

file_lists — list
One sorted list of files per variable, all of the same length
names — list
Variable name of each list
level — int — default 0
See read_one
box — tuple — default None
See read_one

Output Arguments

None.

Example

it = list(R.stream_files([fl, R.find_files(root, "vv", "2015-01-02", "2015-01-03")], ("uu", "vv"))); ok("stream ratio", it[0][2][2, 2]/it[0][1][2, 2] - 2, 0); yes("stream date", it[0][0] == "2015-01-02")
try: list(R.stream_files([fl, R.find_files(root, "vv", "2015-01-01", "2015-01-02")], ("uu", "vv"))); yes("mismatch refused", False)

read_stack

Read files into one array, one snapshot per file.

Description

For records small enough to hold in memory, such as one level over a year.

$$X[t] = \text{read\_one}(f_t)$$

Syntax

stack = read_stack(files, var)stack = read_stack(files, var, level=0, box=None)

Input Arguments

files — list
Files, in the order wanted
var — str
Common or NEMO name of the variable
level — int — default 0
One level, or None for all levels; ignored for 2D fields
box — tuple — default None
(j0, j1, i0, i1) index box, or None for the whole grid

Output Arguments

stack — float
float32 (nt, ny, nx), or (nt, nz, ny, nx) with level=None on a 3D field; land as NaN

s = R.read_stack(fl, "uu", level=1, box=(1, 3, 2, 5)); yes("level and box", s.shape == (2, 2, 3)); ok("value", s[1] - 3, 0)
s = R.read_stack(fl, "uu", level=None); yes("all levels", s.shape == (2, 3, 4, 5)); yes("land NaN", np.isnan(s[0, 0, 0, 0]))

py-kits › datakit › _read › read_mesh

read_mesh

Grid fields by name, from whichever mesh file holds them.

Description

A grid may be described by one mesh file or by several (horizontal, vertical, masks). Fields are looked up by name in each file in turn, with their singleton dimensions removed.

Raises KeyError if a name is in no file.

$$\text{field}(n) = \text{first file holding } n,\ \text{squeezed}$$

Syntax

fields = read_mesh(paths, *names)

Input Arguments

paths — list
Mesh files, searched in order
*names — str
Names of the fields, e.g. 'e1t', 'tmask'

Output Arguments

fields — array
One array per name, singleton dimensions removed; a single array if one name is given. Raises KeyError if a name is in no file

Example

mp = ncfile("mesh.nc", dict(t=1, y=2, x=2), e1t=(("t", "y", "x"), np.ones((1, 2, 2)))); ok("mesh squeezed", R.read_mesh([mp], "e1t").shape[0] - 2, 0)

py-kits › datakit › _source › Source.__init__

Source.__init__

Describe a dataset, raw or derived.

Description

A Source holds what is needed to read any dataset the same way: where its files are, which mesh describes its grid, how often it is sampled, and the tag of the files written from it.

$$\text{Source} = (\text{name},\ \text{root},\ \text{mesh},\ \text{tag},\ \Delta t,\ \text{boundary})$$

Syntax

Source.__init__(name, root, mesh, tag, dt)Source.__init__(name, root, mesh, tag, dt, boundary='t-fold')

Input Arguments

name — str
Dataset name, used in messages and provenance
root — str
Folder holding <var>/<var>_*.nc
mesh — list
Mesh files of the grid
tag — str
Tag in the names of the files written from this dataset
dt — float
Time between snapshots, in seconds
boundary — str — default 't-fold'
North boundary; 't-fold' is the only one orca.halo handles

Output Arguments

None.

Example

Whole test
with test(*[f"datakit._source.Source.{m}" for m in ("__init__", "files", "read", "stream", "groups", "mesh", "grid", "vertical", "coords", "depth", "time_hours", "snapshot")], "datakit._source.source", "datakit._source.derived", "datakit._write.write_field", "datakit._write.provenance", "datakit._write.history", "preprocessing.baroclinic.split", "orcakit.grid_c.vertical_velocity", "datakit._source.Source.point_mask", "datakit._source.Source.point_coords", "orcakit.paths.get"):
    from orcakit import paths as PA
    toml = os.path.join(TMP, "paths.toml")
    with open(toml, "w") as t_: t_.write('one = "~/x"\n')
    saved = os.environ.get("LU_PATHS"); os.environ["LU_PATHS"] = toml
    yes("location read, with ~ expanded", PA.get("one") == os.path.expanduser("~/x"))
    yes("unset location gives a placeholder that names it", "two" in PA.get("two") and "not set" in PA.get("two"))
    if saved is None: del os.environ["LU_PATHS"]
    else: os.environ["LU_PATHS"] = saved
    nz, ny, nx = 3, 12, 16; e3 = np.array([10., 20., 30.]); mesh = os.path.join(TMP, "stage0_mesh.nc")
    tm = np.ones((nz, ny, nx), "i1"); tm[:, 5, 6] = 0
    um = tm*np.roll(tm, -1, axis=2); vm = tm*np.roll(tm, -1, axis=1)
    with netCDF4.Dataset(mesh, "w") as nc:
        for d, s in (("t", 1), ("z", nz), ("y", ny), ("x", nx)): nc.createDimension(d, s)
        nc.createVariable("e3t_0", "f8", ("t", "z"))[:] = e3
        nc.createVariable("e3t_ps", "f8", ("t", "y", "x"))[:] = e3[-1]
        for n_, a in (("tmask", tm), ("umask", um), ("vmask", vm)): nc.createVariable(n_, "i1", ("t", "z", "y", "x"))[:] = a
        for n_ in ("gphit", "glamt", "gphiu", "glamu", "e1t", "e2t", "e1u", "e2u", "e1v", "e2v", "e1f", "e2f"): nc.createVariable(n_, "f8", ("t", "y", "x"))[:] = 1000.
    S = SRC.Source("fake", os.path.join(TMP, "stage0_raw"), [mesh], "fk", 86400.)
    e3u, e3v, u_m, v_m = S.vertical(np.float64)
    yes("masks returned as boolean", u_m.dtype == bool and v_m.dtype == bool)
    ok("e3u is e3t_0 on wet points", (e3u - e3[:, None, None])[:, 1:-2, 1:-2][u_m[:, 1:-2, 1:-2]], 1e-12)
    ok("e3v is e3t_0 on wet points", (e3v - e3[:, None, None])[:, 1:-2, 1:-2][v_m[:, 1:-2, 1:-2]], 1e-12)
    g_ = S.grid(); yes("grid names the boundary and the metrics", g_["boundary"] == "t-fold" and g_["e1u"].shape == (ny, nx) and g_["lat"].shape == (ny, nx))
    yes("mesh reads by name", S.mesh("e3t_0").shape == (nz,))
    try:
        SRC.Source("f", "", [mesh], "f", 1., boundary="closed").vertical(); yes("other boundaries refused", False)
    except NotImplementedError:
        yes("other boundaries refused", True)
    u = 0.1*np.arange(1., nz*ny*nx + 1).reshape(nz, ny, nx)/(nz*ny*nx); u[:, 5, 6] = np.nan
    bt, bc = BC.split(u, e3u, u_m)
    w = e3u*u_m; ok("baroclinic part has zero weighted depth mean", np.nansum(np.nan_to_num(bc)*w, axis=0), 1e-11)
    wet = u_m.all(axis=0); ok("the parts rebuild the field", (bc + bt[None] - u)[:, wet], 1e-12)
    ok("barotropic is the weighted mean, hand value", bt[0, 0] - np.sum(u[:, 0, 0]*e3)/e3.sum(), 1e-12)
    yes("land is NaN in both parts", np.isnan(bc[0, 5, 6]) and np.isnan(bt[5, 6]) and (np.isnan(bc) == ~u_m).all())
    attrs = WR.provenance(source="fake"); yes("provenance has commit, command, date and extras", all(k in attrs for k in ("git_commit", "command", "created", "source")))
    lat, lon = np.zeros((ny, nx)), np.zeros((ny, nx)); dep = np.array([5., 20., 45.]); root = S.root
    for i, date in enumerate(("2015-01-01", "2015-01-02")):
        for var, sign in (("u", 1.), ("v", -1.)):
            p = WR.write_field(root, var, date, sign*(i + 1)*u, lat, lon, 100. + i, "fk", dep, np.float64 if var == "v" else np.float32, attrs)

    yes("resume refuses a file with one part", CM.incompatible(p, ("vomecrty", "vobtcrty"), np.float64))
    WV = lambda a, b, m: grid_c.vertical_velocity(a, b, exchange=orca.halo, **m)

    M_["e3u"] = M_["e3v"] = e3[:, None, None]*np.ones((nz, ny, nx))

    ok("uniform flow in a periodic channel has no w", w_[:, 1:, 1:-1], 1e-12)

    dep_ = WR.write_field(os.path.join(TMP, "stage0_w"), "w", "2015-01-01", w_, lat, lon, 100., "fk", dep, depth_name="depthw")
    with netCDF4.Dataset(dep_) as nc: yes("w files use W levels", nc["vovecrtz"].dimensions == ("depthw", "y", "x"))

    mid_ = WR.write_field(os.path.join(TMP, "hist"), "u", "2015-01-01", bt, lat, lon, 100., "fk", attrs=WR.provenance("PP1 baroclinic: split", raw_))

    yes("without a step, no history", "history" not in WR.provenance(source="x"))

py-kits › datakit › _source › Source.files

Source.files

The files of one variable, between two dates.

Description

$$\text{find\_files}(\text{root}, v, \text{start}, \text{end})$$

Syntax

files = Source.files(var)files = Source.files(var, start=None, end=None)

Input Arguments

var — str
Common or NEMO name of the variable
start — str — default None
First date, inclusive, or None
end — str — default None
Last date, inclusive, or None

Output Arguments

files — list
Paths sorted by date

py-kits › datakit › _source › Source.read

Source.read

Read a variable between two dates into one array.

Description

For records that fit in memory. Use stream for longer ones.

$$X[t] = \text{read\_one}(f_t),\quad t = \text{start}, \dots, \text{end}$$

Syntax

stack = Source.read(var)stack = Source.read(var, start=None, end=None, level=0, box=None)

Input Arguments

var — str
Common or NEMO name of the variable
start — str — default None
First date, inclusive, or None
end — str — default None
Last date, inclusive, or None
level — int — default 0
One level, or None for all levels
box — tuple — default None
(j0, j1, i0, i1) index box, or None for the whole grid

Output Arguments

stack — float
(nt, ny, nx), or (nt, nz, ny, nx) with level=None; land as NaN

Example

ok("barotropic part reads back by common name", np.nan_to_num(Sp.read("vbt")[0] - np.float32(bt)), 1e-6)
ok("baroclinic part reads back by common name", np.nan_to_num(Sp.read("v", level=None)[0] - np.float32(bc)), 1e-6)
r = D.read("u", level=None); ok("read back, single precision", np.nan_to_num(r[1] - np.float32(2*u)), 2e-6); yes("read shape", r.shape == (2, nz, ny, nx))
Whole test
with test(*[f"datakit._source.Source.{m}" for m in ("__init__", "files", "read", "stream", "groups", "mesh", "grid", "vertical", "coords", "depth", "time_hours", "snapshot")], "datakit._source.source", "datakit._source.derived", "datakit._write.write_field", "datakit._write.provenance", "datakit._write.history", "preprocessing.baroclinic.split", "orcakit.grid_c.vertical_velocity", "datakit._source.Source.point_mask", "datakit._source.Source.point_coords", "orcakit.paths.get"):
    from orcakit import paths as PA
    toml = os.path.join(TMP, "paths.toml")
    with open(toml, "w") as t_: t_.write('one = "~/x"\n')
    saved = os.environ.get("LU_PATHS"); os.environ["LU_PATHS"] = toml
    yes("location read, with ~ expanded", PA.get("one") == os.path.expanduser("~/x"))
    yes("unset location gives a placeholder that names it", "two" in PA.get("two") and "not set" in PA.get("two"))
    if saved is None: del os.environ["LU_PATHS"]
    else: os.environ["LU_PATHS"] = saved
    nz, ny, nx = 3, 12, 16; e3 = np.array([10., 20., 30.]); mesh = os.path.join(TMP, "stage0_mesh.nc")
    tm = np.ones((nz, ny, nx), "i1"); tm[:, 5, 6] = 0
    um = tm*np.roll(tm, -1, axis=2); vm = tm*np.roll(tm, -1, axis=1)
    with netCDF4.Dataset(mesh, "w") as nc:
        for d, s in (("t", 1), ("z", nz), ("y", ny), ("x", nx)): nc.createDimension(d, s)
        nc.createVariable("e3t_0", "f8", ("t", "z"))[:] = e3
        nc.createVariable("e3t_ps", "f8", ("t", "y", "x"))[:] = e3[-1]
        for n_, a in (("tmask", tm), ("umask", um), ("vmask", vm)): nc.createVariable(n_, "i1", ("t", "z", "y", "x"))[:] = a
        for n_ in ("gphit", "glamt", "gphiu", "glamu", "e1t", "e2t", "e1u", "e2u", "e1v", "e2v", "e1f", "e2f"): nc.createVariable(n_, "f8", ("t", "y", "x"))[:] = 1000.
    S = SRC.Source("fake", os.path.join(TMP, "stage0_raw"), [mesh], "fk", 86400.)
    e3u, e3v, u_m, v_m = S.vertical(np.float64)
    yes("masks returned as boolean", u_m.dtype == bool and v_m.dtype == bool)
    ok("e3u is e3t_0 on wet points", (e3u - e3[:, None, None])[:, 1:-2, 1:-2][u_m[:, 1:-2, 1:-2]], 1e-12)
    ok("e3v is e3t_0 on wet points", (e3v - e3[:, None, None])[:, 1:-2, 1:-2][v_m[:, 1:-2, 1:-2]], 1e-12)
    g_ = S.grid(); yes("grid names the boundary and the metrics", g_["boundary"] == "t-fold" and g_["e1u"].shape == (ny, nx) and g_["lat"].shape == (ny, nx))
    yes("mesh reads by name", S.mesh("e3t_0").shape == (nz,))
    try:
        SRC.Source("f", "", [mesh], "f", 1., boundary="closed").vertical(); yes("other boundaries refused", False)
    except NotImplementedError:
        yes("other boundaries refused", True)
    u = 0.1*np.arange(1., nz*ny*nx + 1).reshape(nz, ny, nx)/(nz*ny*nx); u[:, 5, 6] = np.nan
    bt, bc = BC.split(u, e3u, u_m)
    w = e3u*u_m; ok("baroclinic part has zero weighted depth mean", np.nansum(np.nan_to_num(bc)*w, axis=0), 1e-11)
    wet = u_m.all(axis=0); ok("the parts rebuild the field", (bc + bt[None] - u)[:, wet], 1e-12)
    ok("barotropic is the weighted mean, hand value", bt[0, 0] - np.sum(u[:, 0, 0]*e3)/e3.sum(), 1e-12)
    yes("land is NaN in both parts", np.isnan(bc[0, 5, 6]) and np.isnan(bt[5, 6]) and (np.isnan(bc) == ~u_m).all())
    attrs = WR.provenance(source="fake"); yes("provenance has commit, command, date and extras", all(k in attrs for k in ("git_commit", "command", "created", "source")))
    lat, lon = np.zeros((ny, nx)), np.zeros((ny, nx)); dep = np.array([5., 20., 45.]); root = S.root
    for i, date in enumerate(("2015-01-01", "2015-01-02")):
        for var, sign in (("u", 1.), ("v", -1.)):
            p = WR.write_field(root, var, date, sign*(i + 1)*u, lat, lon, 100. + i, "fk", dep, np.float64 if var == "v" else np.float32, attrs)
    yes("path follows the convention", p.endswith(os.path.join("vomecrty", "vomecrty_fk_2015-01-02.nc")) and not glob.glob(p + ".tmp*"))
    with netCDF4.Dataset(p) as nc:
        yes("file convention", nc["vomecrty"].dimensions == ("deptht", "y", "x") and nc["time_counter"].shape == () and np.isnan(nc["vomecrty"]._FillValue) and nc["vomecrty"].filters()["zlib"] and nc["vomecrty"].dtype == np.float64 and nc.source == "fake")
    bt_path = WR.write_field(os.path.join(TMP, "stage0_bt"), "v", "2015-01-01", bt, lat, lon, 100., "fk")
    with netCDF4.Dataset(bt_path) as nc: yes("2D field has no depth", nc["vomecrty"].dimensions == ("y", "x"))
    both = WR.write_field(os.path.join(TMP, "stage0_split"), "v", "2015-01-01", bc, lat, lon, 100., "fk", dep, np.float64, attrs, {"vobtcrty": bt})
    Sp = SRC.derived(os.path.join(TMP, "stage0_split"), S)
    yes("both parts share one file", Sp.files("vbt") == Sp.files("v") == [both])
    with netCDF4.Dataset(both) as nc: yes("barotropic part is 2D, baroclinic 3D, same type", nc["vobtcrty"].dimensions == ("y", "x") and nc["vomecrty"].dimensions == ("deptht", "y", "x") and nc["vobtcrty"].dtype == np.float64)
    ok("barotropic part reads back by common name", np.nan_to_num(Sp.read("vbt")[0] - np.float32(bt)), 1e-6)
    ok("baroclinic part reads back by common name", np.nan_to_num(Sp.read("v", level=None)[0] - np.float32(bc)), 1e-6)
    import _common as CM
    yes("resume accepts the same precision", not CM.incompatible(both, ("vomecrty", "vobtcrty"), np.float64))
    yes("resume refuses another precision", CM.incompatible(both, ("vomecrty", "vobtcrty"), np.float32))
    yes("resume refuses a file with one part", CM.incompatible(p, ("vomecrty", "vobtcrty"), np.float64))
    WV = lambda a, b, m: grid_c.vertical_velocity(a, b, exchange=orca.halo, **m)
    yes("point mask by name", S.point_mask("U").dtype == bool)
    pc = S.point_coords("U"); yes("point coordinates from the mesh", len(pc) == 2 and pc[0].shape == (ny, nx))
    gr = S.grid(); M_ = dict(e3u=e3u, e3v=e3v, umask=np.ones_like(u_m), vmask=np.ones_like(v_m), tmask=np.ones_like(u_m), e1t=gr["e1t"], e2t=gr["e2t"], e1v=gr["e1v"], e2u=gr["e2u"])
    M_["e3u"] = M_["e3v"] = e3[:, None, None]*np.ones((nz, ny, nx))
    w_ = WV(np.full((nz, ny, nx), 0.3), np.full((nz, ny, nx), 0.0), M_)
    ok("uniform flow in a periodic channel has no w", w_[:, 1:, 1:-1], 1e-12)
    jj_ = np.arange(ny)[None, :, None]*np.ones((nz, ny, nx)); w_ = WV(np.zeros((nz, ny, nx)), 1e-3*jj_, M_)
    ok("constant divergence gives w by hand, top of the column", w_[0, 3:-3, 3:-3] + 1e-6*e3[:-1].sum(), 1e-12)
    yes("w is NaN on land", np.isnan(WV(np.zeros((nz, ny, nx)), np.zeros((nz, ny, nx)), {**M_, "tmask": tm.astype(bool)})[0, 5, 6]))
    dep_ = WR.write_field(os.path.join(TMP, "stage0_w"), "w", "2015-01-01", w_, lat, lon, 100., "fk", dep, depth_name="depthw")
    with netCDF4.Dataset(dep_) as nc: yes("w files use W levels", nc["vovecrtz"].dimensions == ("depthw", "y", "x"))
    raw_ = os.path.join(TMP, "raw_hist.nc")
    with netCDF4.Dataset(raw_, "w") as nc: nc.history = "made upstream"
    h1 = WR.provenance("PP1 baroclinic: split", raw_)["history"]
    yes("first step: its line, then the raw file and its own history", h1.splitlines()[0].endswith(" | " + os.path.basename(sys.argv[0]) + " " + " ".join(sys.argv[1:])) and "PP1 baroclinic: split" in h1.splitlines()[0] and h1.splitlines()[1:] == ["source file: raw_hist.nc", "made upstream"])
    mid_ = WR.write_field(os.path.join(TMP, "hist"), "u", "2015-01-01", bt, lat, lon, 100., "fk", attrs=WR.provenance("PP1 baroclinic: split", raw_))
    h2 = WR.provenance("PP4 spatial_filter: low", mid_)["history"].splitlines()
    yes("second step goes on top of the first, newest first", "PP4" in h2[0] and "PP1" in h2[1] and h2[2] == "source file: raw_hist.nc")
    yes("no git commit in history", all("git" not in l for l in h2))
    h3 = WR.provenance("PP7 running: cov", {"u": mid_, "v": raw_})["history"].splitlines()
    yes("two inputs keep both histories, indented", h3[1] == "inputs: u" and h3[2].startswith("  ") and "inputs: v" in h3 and "  source file: raw_hist.nc" in h3)
    yes("without a step, no history", "history" not in WR.provenance(source="x"))
    yes("output path", BC.output_path("d", "vomecrty", "fk", "1993-01") == os.path.join("d", "split", "vomecrty", "vomecrty_fk_1993-01.nc"))
    D = SRC.derived(root, S); yes("derived keeps the grid, tag and step", D.mesh_files == [mesh] and D.tag == "fk" and D.dt == 86400. and D.name == "stage0_raw")
    yes("common and source names find the same files", D.files("u") == D.files("vozocrtx") and len(D.files("u", "2015-01-02")) == 1)
    r = D.read("u", level=None); ok("read back, single precision", np.nan_to_num(r[1] - np.float32(2*u)), 2e-6); yes("read shape", r.shape == (2, nz, ny, nx))
    ok("double precision survives the round trip", np.nan_to_num(D.snapshot(D.files("v")[0], "v", np.float64) + u), 1e-14)
    got = list(D.stream("u", "v", level=1)); yes("stream by common names", [g[0] for g in got] == ["2015-01-01", "2015-01-02"] and got[0][1].shape == (ny, nx))
    os.remove(D.files("v", "2015-01-02")[0]); gr, miss = D.groups("u", "v"); yes("groups keeps common dates and names the others", [g[0] for g in gr] == ["2015-01-01"] and miss == ["2015-01-02"])
    f0 = D.files("u")[0]; ok("time kept", D.time_hours(f0) - 100., 1e-9); ok("depth kept", D.depth(f0) - dep, 1e-5); yes("coordinates kept", D.coords(f0)[0].shape == (ny, nx))
    other = os.path.join(TMP, "stage0_time.nc")
    with netCDF4.Dataset(other, "w") as nc:
        nc.createDimension("time_counter", 1); t = nc.createVariable("time_counter", "f8", ("time_counter",)); t.units, t.calendar = "seconds since 1950-01-02", "gregorian"; t[:] = 3600.
    ok("other time units convert: one day and one hour", D.time_hours(other) - 25., 1e-9)
    for name_ in ("glorys04", "glorys12", "cmems"): yes(f"source finds {name_}", SRC.source(name_).name == name_)

py-kits › datakit › _source › Source.stream

Source.stream

Read several variables one snapshot at a time.

Description

Keeps one date in memory, so any length of record can be processed, with the dates of all variables checked to match.

$$(d, x_1, \dots, x_n) \text{ for each date } d$$

Syntax

Source.stream(*variables)Source.stream(*variables, start=None, end=None, level=0, box=None)

Input Arguments

*variables — str
Common or NEMO names
start — str — default None
First date, inclusive, or None
end — str — default None
Last date, inclusive, or None
level — int — default 0
One level, or None for all levels
box — tuple — default None
(j0, j1, i0, i1) index box, or None for the whole grid

Output Arguments

None.

Example

got = list(D.stream("u", "v", level=1)); yes("stream by common names", [g[0] for g in got] == ["2015-01-01", "2015-01-02"] and got[0][1].shape == (ny, nx))

    ok("barotropic part reads back by common name", np.nan_to_num(Sp.read("vbt")[0] - np.float32(bt)), 1e-6)
    ok("baroclinic part reads back by common name", np.nan_to_num(Sp.read("v", level=None)[0] - np.float32(bc)), 1e-6)
    import _common as CM
    yes("resume accepts the same precision", not CM.incompatible(both, ("vomecrty", "vobtcrty"), np.float64))
    yes("resume refuses another precision", CM.incompatible(both, ("vomecrty", "vobtcrty"), np.float32))
    yes("resume refuses a file with one part", CM.incompatible(p, ("vomecrty", "vobtcrty"), np.float64))
    WV = lambda a, b, m: grid_c.vertical_velocity(a, b, exchange=orca.halo, **m)
    yes("point mask by name", S.point_mask("U").dtype == bool)
    pc = S.point_coords("U"); yes("point coordinates from the mesh", len(pc) == 2 and pc[0].shape == (ny, nx))
    gr = S.grid(); M_ = dict(e3u=e3u, e3v=e3v, umask=np.ones_like(u_m), vmask=np.ones_like(v_m), tmask=np.ones_like(u_m), e1t=gr["e1t"], e2t=gr["e2t"], e1v=gr["e1v"], e2u=gr["e2u"])
    M_["e3u"] = M_["e3v"] = e3[:, None, None]*np.ones((nz, ny, nx))
    w_ = WV(np.full((nz, ny, nx), 0.3), np.full((nz, ny, nx), 0.0), M_)
    ok("uniform flow in a periodic channel has no w", w_[:, 1:, 1:-1], 1e-12)
    jj_ = np.arange(ny)[None, :, None]*np.ones((nz, ny, nx)); w_ = WV(np.zeros((nz, ny, nx)), 1e-3*jj_, M_)
    ok("constant divergence gives w by hand, top of the column", w_[0, 3:-3, 3:-3] + 1e-6*e3[:-1].sum(), 1e-12)
    yes("w is NaN on land", np.isnan(WV(np.zeros((nz, ny, nx)), np.zeros((nz, ny, nx)), {**M_, "tmask": tm.astype(bool)})[0, 5, 6]))
    dep_ = WR.write_field(os.path.join(TMP, "stage0_w"), "w", "2015-01-01", w_, lat, lon, 100., "fk", dep, depth_name="depthw")
    with netCDF4.Dataset(dep_) as nc: yes("w files use W levels", nc["vovecrtz"].dimensions == ("depthw", "y", "x"))
    raw_ = os.path.join(TMP, "raw_hist.nc")
    with netCDF4.Dataset(raw_, "w") as nc: nc.history = "made upstream"
    h1 = WR.provenance("PP1 baroclinic: split", raw_)["history"]
    yes("first step: its line, then the raw file and its own history", h1.splitlines()[0].endswith(" | " + os.path.basename(sys.argv[0]) + " " + " ".join(sys.argv[1:])) and "PP1 baroclinic: split" in h1.splitlines()[0] and h1.splitlines()[1:] == ["source file: raw_hist.nc", "made upstream"])
    mid_ = WR.write_field(os.path.join(TMP, "hist"), "u", "2015-01-01", bt, lat, lon, 100., "fk", attrs=WR.provenance("PP1 baroclinic: split", raw_))
    h2 = WR.provenance("PP4 spatial_filter: low", mid_)["history"].splitlines()
    yes("second step goes on top of the first, newest first", "PP4" in h2[0] and "PP1" in h2[1] and h2[2] == "source file: raw_hist.nc")
    yes("no git commit in history", all("git" not in l for l in h2))
    h3 = WR.provenance("PP7 running: cov", {"u": mid_, "v": raw_})["history"].splitlines()
    yes("two inputs keep both histories, indented", h3[1] == "inputs: u" and h3[2].startswith("  ") and "inputs: v" in h3 and "  source file: raw_hist.nc" in h3)
    yes("without a step, no history", "history" not in WR.provenance(source="x"))
    yes("output path", BC.output_path("d", "vomecrty", "fk", "1993-01") == os.path.join("d", "split", "vomecrty", "vomecrty_fk_1993-01.nc"))
    D = SRC.derived(root, S); yes("derived keeps the grid, tag and step", D.mesh_files == [mesh] and D.tag == "fk" and D.dt == 86400. and D.name == "stage0_raw")
    yes("common and source names find the same files", D.files("u") == D.files("vozocrtx") and len(D.files("u", "2015-01-02")) == 1)
    r = D.read("u", level=None); ok("read back, single precision", np.nan_to_num(r[1] - np.float32(2*u)), 2e-6); yes("read shape", r.shape == (2, nz, ny, nx))
    ok("double precision survives the round trip", np.nan_to_num(D.snapshot(D.files("v")[0], "v", np.float64) + u), 1e-14)
    got = list(D.stream("u", "v", level=1)); yes("stream by common names", [g[0] for g in got] == ["2015-01-01", "2015-01-02"] and got[0][1].shape == (ny, nx))
    os.remove(D.files("v", "2015-01-02")[0]); gr, miss = D.groups("u", "v"); yes("groups keeps common dates and names the others", [g[0] for g in gr] == ["2015-01-01"] and miss == ["2015-01-02"])
    f0 = D.files("u")[0]; ok("time kept", D.time_hours(f0) - 100., 1e-9); ok("depth kept", D.depth(f0) - dep, 1e-5); yes("coordinates kept", D.coords(f0)[0].shape == (ny, nx))
    other = os.path.join(TMP, "stage0_time.nc")
    with netCDF4.Dataset(other, "w") as nc:
        nc.createDimension("time_counter", 1); t = nc.createVariable("time_counter", "f8", ("time_counter",)); t.units, t.calendar = "seconds since 1950-01-02", "gregorian"; t[:] = 3600.
    ok("other time units convert: one day and one hour", D.time_hours(other) - 25., 1e-9)
    for name_ in ("glorys04", "glorys12", "cmems"): yes(f"source finds {name_}", SRC.source(name_).name == name_)

py-kits › datakit › _source › Source.groups

Source.groups

The dates on which all the variables have a file, with those files.

Description

Processing that needs several variables per date, such as u and v, can only use dates where all of them exist. This lists those dates with their files, and the dates where some are missing, so a run can report them.

$$D = \bigcap_k \text{dates}(v_k),\qquad \text{missing} = \bigcup_k \text{dates}(v_k) \setminus D$$

Syntax

groups, missing = Source.groups(*variables)groups, missing = Source.groups(*variables, start=None, end=None)

Input Arguments

*variables — str
Common or NEMO names
start — str — default None
First date, inclusive, or None
end — str — default None
Last date, inclusive, or None

Output Arguments

groups — list
Sorted (date, path, path, ...), one path per variable
missing — list
Sorted dates on which only some of the variables have a file

Example

os.remove(D.files("v", "2015-01-02")[0]); gr, miss = D.groups("u", "v"); yes("groups keeps common dates and names the others", [g[0] for g in gr] == ["2015-01-01"] and miss == ["2015-01-02"])

with test(*[f"datakit._source.Source.{m}" for m in ("__init__", "files", "read", "stream", "groups", "mesh", "grid", "vertical", "coords", "depth", "time_hours", "snapshot")], "datakit._source.source", "datakit._source.derived", "datakit._write.write_field", "datakit._write.provenance", "datakit._write.history", "preprocessing.baroclinic.split", "orcakit.grid_c.vertical_velocity", "datakit._source.Source.point_mask", "datakit._source.Source.point_coords", "orcakit.paths.get"):

        for d, s in (("t", 1), ("z", nz), ("y", ny), ("x", nx)): nc.createDimension(d, s)
        nc.createVariable("e3t_0", "f8", ("t", "z"))[:] = e3
        nc.createVariable("e3t_ps", "f8", ("t", "y", "x"))[:] = e3[-1]
        for n_, a in (("tmask", tm), ("umask", um), ("vmask", vm)): nc.createVariable(n_, "i1", ("t", "z", "y", "x"))[:] = a
        for n_ in ("gphit", "glamt", "gphiu", "glamu", "e1t", "e2t", "e1u", "e2u", "e1v", "e2v", "e1f", "e2f"): nc.createVariable(n_, "f8", ("t", "y", "x"))[:] = 1000.
    S = SRC.Source("fake", os.path.join(TMP, "stage0_raw"), [mesh], "fk", 86400.)
    e3u, e3v, u_m, v_m = S.vertical(np.float64)
    yes("masks returned as boolean", u_m.dtype == bool and v_m.dtype == bool)
    ok("e3u is e3t_0 on wet points", (e3u - e3[:, None, None])[:, 1:-2, 1:-2][u_m[:, 1:-2, 1:-2]], 1e-12)
    ok("e3v is e3t_0 on wet points", (e3v - e3[:, None, None])[:, 1:-2, 1:-2][v_m[:, 1:-2, 1:-2]], 1e-12)
    g_ = S.grid(); yes("grid names the boundary and the metrics", g_["boundary"] == "t-fold" and g_["e1u"].shape == (ny, nx) and g_["lat"].shape == (ny, nx))
    yes("mesh reads by name", S.mesh("e3t_0").shape == (nz,))
    try:
        SRC.Source("f", "", [mesh], "f", 1., boundary="closed").vertical(); yes("other boundaries refused", False)
    except NotImplementedError:
        yes("other boundaries refused", True)
    u = 0.1*np.arange(1., nz*ny*nx + 1).reshape(nz, ny, nx)/(nz*ny*nx); u[:, 5, 6] = np.nan
    bt, bc = BC.split(u, e3u, u_m)
    w = e3u*u_m; ok("baroclinic part has zero weighted depth mean", np.nansum(np.nan_to_num(bc)*w, axis=0), 1e-11)
    wet = u_m.all(axis=0); ok("the parts rebuild the field", (bc + bt[None] - u)[:, wet], 1e-12)
    ok("barotropic is the weighted mean, hand value", bt[0, 0] - np.sum(u[:, 0, 0]*e3)/e3.sum(), 1e-12)
    yes("land is NaN in both parts", np.isnan(bc[0, 5, 6]) and np.isnan(bt[5, 6]) and (np.isnan(bc) == ~u_m).all())
    attrs = WR.provenance(source="fake"); yes("provenance has commit, command, date and extras", all(k in attrs for k in ("git_commit", "command", "created", "source")))
    lat, lon = np.zeros((ny, nx)), np.zeros((ny, nx)); dep = np.array([5., 20., 45.]); root = S.root
    for i, date in enumerate(("2015-01-01", "2015-01-02")):
        for var, sign in (("u", 1.), ("v", -1.)):

Source.mesh

Grid fields by name, from the dataset's mesh files.

Description

$$\text{read\_mesh}(\text{mesh files}, n_1, \dots)$$

Syntax

fields = Source.mesh(*names)

Input Arguments

*names — str
Names of the fields, e.g. 'e1t', 'tmask'

Output Arguments

fields — array
One array per name, or a single array for one name

with test(*[f"datakit._source.Source.{m}" for m in ("__init__", "files", "read", "stream", "groups", "mesh", "grid", "vertical", "coords", "depth", "time_hours", "snapshot")], "datakit._source.source", "datakit._source.derived", "datakit._write.write_field", "datakit._write.provenance", "datakit._write.history", "preprocessing.baroclinic.split", "orcakit.grid_c.vertical_velocity", "datakit._source.Source.point_mask", "datakit._source.Source.point_coords", "orcakit.paths.get"):
    from orcakit import paths as PA
    toml = os.path.join(TMP, "paths.toml")
    with open(toml, "w") as t_: t_.write('one = "~/x"\n')
    saved = os.environ.get("LU_PATHS"); os.environ["LU_PATHS"] = toml
    yes("location read, with ~ expanded", PA.get("one") == os.path.expanduser("~/x"))
    yes("unset location gives a placeholder that names it", "two" in PA.get("two") and "not set" in PA.get("two"))
    if saved is None: del os.environ["LU_PATHS"]
    else: os.environ["LU_PATHS"] = saved
    nz, ny, nx = 3, 12, 16; e3 = np.array([10., 20., 30.]); mesh = os.path.join(TMP, "stage0_mesh.nc")
    tm = np.ones((nz, ny, nx), "i1"); tm[:, 5, 6] = 0
    um = tm*np.roll(tm, -1, axis=2); vm = tm*np.roll(tm, -1, axis=1)
    with netCDF4.Dataset(mesh, "w") as nc:
        for d, s in (("t", 1), ("z", nz), ("y", ny), ("x", nx)): nc.createDimension(d, s)
        nc.createVariable("e3t_0", "f8", ("t", "z"))[:] = e3
        nc.createVariable("e3t_ps", "f8", ("t", "y", "x"))[:] = e3[-1]
        for n_, a in (("tmask", tm), ("umask", um), ("vmask", vm)): nc.createVariable(n_, "i1", ("t", "z", "y", "x"))[:] = a
        for n_ in ("gphit", "glamt", "gphiu", "glamu", "e1t", "e2t", "e1u", "e2u", "e1v", "e2v", "e1f", "e2f"): nc.createVariable(n_, "f8", ("t", "y", "x"))[:] = 1000.
    S = SRC.Source("fake", os.path.join(TMP, "stage0_raw"), [mesh], "fk", 86400.)
    e3u, e3v, u_m, v_m = S.vertical(np.float64)
    yes("masks returned as boolean", u_m.dtype == bool and v_m.dtype == bool)
    ok("e3u is e3t_0 on wet points", (e3u - e3[:, None, None])[:, 1:-2, 1:-2][u_m[:, 1:-2, 1:-2]], 1e-12)
    ok("e3v is e3t_0 on wet points", (e3v - e3[:, None, None])[:, 1:-2, 1:-2][v_m[:, 1:-2, 1:-2]], 1e-12)
    g_ = S.grid(); yes("grid names the boundary and the metrics", g_["boundary"] == "t-fold" and g_["e1u"].shape == (ny, nx) and g_["lat"].shape == (ny, nx))
    yes("mesh reads by name", S.mesh("e3t_0").shape == (nz,))
    try:
        SRC.Source("f", "", [mesh], "f", 1., boundary="closed").vertical(); yes("other boundaries refused", False)
    except NotImplementedError:
        yes("other boundaries refused", True)
    u = 0.1*np.arange(1., nz*ny*nx + 1).reshape(nz, ny, nx)/(nz*ny*nx); u[:, 5, 6] = np.nan
    bt, bc = BC.split(u, e3u, u_m)
    w = e3u*u_m; ok("baroclinic part has zero weighted depth mean", np.nansum(np.nan_to_num(bc)*w, axis=0), 1e-11)
    wet = u_m.all(axis=0); ok("the parts rebuild the field", (bc + bt[None] - u)[:, wet], 1e-12)
    ok("barotropic is the weighted mean, hand value", bt[0, 0] - np.sum(u[:, 0, 0]*e3)/e3.sum(), 1e-12)
    yes("land is NaN in both parts", np.isnan(bc[0, 5, 6]) and np.isnan(bt[5, 6]) and (np.isnan(bc) == ~u_m).all())
    attrs = WR.provenance(source="fake"); yes("provenance has commit, command, date and extras", all(k in attrs for k in ("git_commit", "command", "created", "source")))
    lat, lon = np.zeros((ny, nx)), np.zeros((ny, nx)); dep = np.array([5., 20., 45.]); root = S.root
    for i, date in enumerate(("2015-01-01", "2015-01-02")):
        for var, sign in (("u", 1.), ("v", -1.)):
            p = WR.write_field(root, var, date, sign*(i + 1)*u, lat, lon, 100. + i, "fk", dep, np.float64 if var == "v" else np.float32, attrs)
    yes("path follows the convention", p.endswith(os.path.join("vomecrty", "vomecrty_fk_2015-01-02.nc")) and not glob.glob(p + ".tmp*"))
    with netCDF4.Dataset(p) as nc:
        yes("file convention", nc["vomecrty"].dimensions == ("deptht", "y", "x") and nc["time_counter"].shape == () and np.isnan(nc["vomecrty"]._FillValue) and nc["vomecrty"].filters()["zlib"] and nc["vomecrty"].dtype == np.float64 and nc.source == "fake")
    bt_path = WR.write_field(os.path.join(TMP, "stage0_bt"), "v", "2015-01-01", bt, lat, lon, 100., "fk")
    with netCDF4.Dataset(bt_path) as nc: yes("2D field has no depth", nc["vomecrty"].dimensions == ("y", "x"))
    both = WR.write_field(os.path.join(TMP, "stage0_split"), "v", "2015-01-01", bc, lat, lon, 100., "fk", dep, np.float64, attrs, {"vobtcrty": bt})
    Sp = SRC.derived(os.path.join(TMP, "stage0_split"), S)
    yes("both parts share one file", Sp.files("vbt") == Sp.files("v") == [both])
    with netCDF4.Dataset(both) as nc: yes("barotropic part is 2D, baroclinic 3D, same type", nc["vobtcrty"].dimensions == ("y", "x") and nc["vomecrty"].dimensions == ("deptht", "y", "x") and nc["vobtcrty"].dtype == np.float64)
    ok("barotropic part reads back by common name", np.nan_to_num(Sp.read("vbt")[0] - np.float32(bt)), 1e-6)
    ok("baroclinic part reads back by common name", np.nan_to_num(Sp.read("v", level=None)[0] - np.float32(bc)), 1e-6)
    import _common as CM
    yes("resume accepts the same precision", not CM.incompatible(both, ("vomecrty", "vobtcrty"), np.float64))
    yes("resume refuses another precision", CM.incompatible(both, ("vomecrty", "vobtcrty"), np.float32))
    yes("resume refuses a file with one part", CM.incompatible(p, ("vomecrty", "vobtcrty"), np.float64))
    WV = lambda a, b, m: grid_c.vertical_velocity(a, b, exchange=orca.halo, **m)
    yes("point mask by name", S.point_mask("U").dtype == bool)
    pc = S.point_coords("U"); yes("point coordinates from the mesh", len(pc) == 2 and pc[0].shape == (ny, nx))
    gr = S.grid(); M_ = dict(e3u=e3u, e3v=e3v, umask=np.ones_like(u_m), vmask=np.ones_like(v_m), tmask=np.ones_like(u_m), e1t=gr["e1t"], e2t=gr["e2t"], e1v=gr["e1v"], e2u=gr["e2u"])
    M_["e3u"] = M_["e3v"] = e3[:, None, None]*np.ones((nz, ny, nx))
    w_ = WV(np.full((nz, ny, nx), 0.3), np.full((nz, ny, nx), 0.0), M_)
    ok("uniform flow in a periodic channel has no w", w_[:, 1:, 1:-1], 1e-12)
    jj_ = np.arange(ny)[None, :, None]*np.ones((nz, ny, nx)); w_ = WV(np.zeros((nz, ny, nx)), 1e-3*jj_, M_)
    ok("constant divergence gives w by hand, top of the column", w_[0, 3:-3, 3:-3] + 1e-6*e3[:-1].sum(), 1e-12)
    yes("w is NaN on land", np.isnan(WV(np.zeros((nz, ny, nx)), np.zeros((nz, ny, nx)), {**M_, "tmask": tm.astype(bool)})[0, 5, 6]))
    dep_ = WR.write_field(os.path.join(TMP, "stage0_w"), "w", "2015-01-01", w_, lat, lon, 100., "fk", dep, depth_name="depthw")
    with netCDF4.Dataset(dep_) as nc: yes("w files use W levels", nc["vovecrtz"].dimensions == ("depthw", "y", "x"))
    raw_ = os.path.join(TMP, "raw_hist.nc")
    with netCDF4.Dataset(raw_, "w") as nc: nc.history = "made upstream"
    h1 = WR.provenance("PP1 baroclinic: split", raw_)["history"]
    yes("first step: its line, then the raw file and its own history", h1.splitlines()[0].endswith(" | " + os.path.basename(sys.argv[0]) + " " + " ".join(sys.argv[1:])) and "PP1 baroclinic: split" in h1.splitlines()[0] and h1.splitlines()[1:] == ["source file: raw_hist.nc", "made upstream"])
    mid_ = WR.write_field(os.path.join(TMP, "hist"), "u", "2015-01-01", bt, lat, lon, 100., "fk", attrs=WR.provenance("PP1 baroclinic: split", raw_))
    h2 = WR.provenance("PP4 spatial_filter: low", mid_)["history"].splitlines()
    yes("second step goes on top of the first, newest first", "PP4" in h2[0] and "PP1" in h2[1] and h2[2] == "source file: raw_hist.nc")
    yes("no git commit in history", all("git" not in l for l in h2))
    h3 = WR.provenance("PP7 running: cov", {"u": mid_, "v": raw_})["history"].splitlines()
    yes("two inputs keep both histories, indented", h3[1] == "inputs: u" and h3[2].startswith("  ") and "inputs: v" in h3 and "  source file: raw_hist.nc" in h3)
    yes("without a step, no history", "history" not in WR.provenance(source="x"))
    yes("output path", BC.output_path("d", "vomecrty", "fk", "1993-01") == os.path.join("d", "split", "vomecrty", "vomecrty_fk_1993-01.nc"))
    D = SRC.derived(root, S); yes("derived keeps the grid, tag and step", D.mesh_files == [mesh] and D.tag == "fk" and D.dt == 86400. and D.name == "stage0_raw")
    yes("common and source names find the same files", D.files("u") == D.files("vozocrtx") and len(D.files("u", "2015-01-02")) == 1)
    r = D.read("u", level=None); ok("read back, single precision", np.nan_to_num(r[1] - np.float32(2*u)), 2e-6); yes("read shape", r.shape == (2, nz, ny, nx))
    ok("double precision survives the round trip", np.nan_to_num(D.snapshot(D.files("v")[0], "v", np.float64) + u), 1e-14)
    got = list(D.stream("u", "v", level=1)); yes("stream by common names", [g[0] for g in got] == ["2015-01-01", "2015-01-02"] and got[0][1].shape == (ny, nx))
    os.remove(D.files("v", "2015-01-02")[0]); gr, miss = D.groups("u", "v"); yes("groups keeps common dates and names the others", [g[0] for g in gr] == ["2015-01-01"] and miss == ["2015-01-02"])
    f0 = D.files("u")[0]; ok("time kept", D.time_hours(f0) - 100., 1e-9); ok("depth kept", D.depth(f0) - dep, 1e-5); yes("coordinates kept", D.coords(f0)[0].shape == (ny, nx))
    other = os.path.join(TMP, "stage0_time.nc")
    with netCDF4.Dataset(other, "w") as nc:
        nc.createDimension("time_counter", 1); t = nc.createVariable("time_counter", "f8", ("time_counter",)); t.units, t.calendar = "seconds since 1950-01-02", "gregorian"; t[:] = 3600.
    ok("other time units convert: one day and one hour", D.time_hours(other) - 25., 1e-9)
    for name_ in ("glorys04", "glorys12", "cmems"): yes(f"source finds {name_}", SRC.source(name_).name == name_)

See also

read_mesh | Source.grid

py-kits › datakit › _source › Source.point_mask

Source.point_mask

The wet mask of one kind of C-grid point.

Description

T, U, V and F points have different masks: a U point is wet only when both its T-cells are. The mask must match the point a field lives on.

$$m_p = p\text{mask from the mesh},\ p \in \{T, U, V, F\}$$

Syntax

mask = Source.point_mask(point)

Input Arguments

point — str
'T', 'U', 'V' or 'F'

Output Arguments

mask — bool
(nz, ny, nx), True on water

Example

yes("point mask by name", S.point_mask("U").dtype == bool)

    yes("first step: its line, then the raw file and its own history", h1.splitlines()[0].endswith(" | " + os.path.basename(sys.argv[0]) + " " + " ".join(sys.argv[1:])) and "PP1 baroclinic: split" in h1.splitlines()[0] and h1.splitlines()[1:] == ["source file: raw_hist.nc", "made upstream"])
    mid_ = WR.write_field(os.path.join(TMP, "hist"), "u", "2015-01-01", bt, lat, lon, 100., "fk", attrs=WR.provenance("PP1 baroclinic: split", raw_))
    h2 = WR.provenance("PP4 spatial_filter: low", mid_)["history"].splitlines()
    yes("second step goes on top of the first, newest first", "PP4" in h2[0] and "PP1" in h2[1] and h2[2] == "source file: raw_hist.nc")
    yes("no git commit in history", all("git" not in l for l in h2))
    h3 = WR.provenance("PP7 running: cov", {"u": mid_, "v": raw_})["history"].splitlines()
    yes("two inputs keep both histories, indented", h3[1] == "inputs: u" and h3[2].startswith("  ") and "inputs: v" in h3 and "  source file: raw_hist.nc" in h3)
    yes("without a step, no history", "history" not in WR.provenance(source="x"))
    yes("output path", BC.output_path("d", "vomecrty", "fk", "1993-01") == os.path.join("d", "split", "vomecrty", "vomecrty_fk_1993-01.nc"))
    D = SRC.derived(root, S); yes("derived keeps the grid, tag and step", D.mesh_files == [mesh] and D.tag == "fk" and D.dt == 86400. and D.name == "stage0_raw")
    yes("common and source names find the same files", D.files("u") == D.files("vozocrtx") and len(D.files("u", "2015-01-02")) == 1)
    r = D.read("u", level=None); ok("read back, single precision", np.nan_to_num(r[1] - np.float32(2*u)), 2e-6); yes("read shape", r.shape == (2, nz, ny, nx))
    ok("double precision survives the round trip", np.nan_to_num(D.snapshot(D.files("v")[0], "v", np.float64) + u), 1e-14)
    got = list(D.stream("u", "v", level=1)); yes("stream by common names", [g[0] for g in got] == ["2015-01-01", "2015-01-02"] and got[0][1].shape == (ny, nx))
    os.remove(D.files("v", "2015-01-02")[0]); gr, miss = D.groups("u", "v"); yes("groups keeps common dates and names the others", [g[0] for g in gr] == ["2015-01-01"] and miss == ["2015-01-02"])
    f0 = D.files("u")[0]; ok("time kept", D.time_hours(f0) - 100., 1e-9); ok("depth kept", D.depth(f0) - dep, 1e-5); yes("coordinates kept", D.coords(f0)[0].shape == (ny, nx))
    other = os.path.join(TMP, "stage0_time.nc")
    with netCDF4.Dataset(other, "w") as nc:
        nc.createDimension("time_counter", 1); t = nc.createVariable("time_counter", "f8", ("time_counter",)); t.units, t.calendar = "seconds since 1950-01-02", "gregorian"; t[:] = 3600.
    ok("other time units convert: one day and one hour", D.time_hours(other) - 25., 1e-9)
    for name_ in ("glorys04", "glorys12", "cmems"): yes(f"source finds {name_}", SRC.source(name_).name == name_)

py-kits › datakit › _source › Source.grid

Source.grid

The horizontal grid: T-point positions and the cell widths at every point type.

Description

Differences, divergences and areas on the C grid all need the widths e1 and e2 of the cells at the right points. They are returned together, with the type of north boundary.

$$\{\varphi_T,\ \lambda_T,\ e_{1p},\ e_{2p} : p \in \{t, u, v, f\}\}$$

Syntax

grid = Source.grid()

Input Arguments

None.

Output Arguments

grid — dict
'lat' and 'lon' of T-points, 'boundary', and the scale factors e1t, e2t, e1u, e2u, e1v, e2v, e1f, e2f in metres, each (ny, nx)

Example

g_ = S.grid(); yes("grid names the boundary and the metrics", g_["boundary"] == "t-fold" and g_["e1u"].shape == (ny, nx) and g_["lat"].shape == (ny, nx))
gr = S.grid(); M_ = dict(e3u=e3u, e3v=e3v, umask=np.ones_like(u_m), vmask=np.ones_like(v_m), tmask=np.ones_like(u_m), e1t=gr["e1t"], e2t=gr["e2t"], e1v=gr["e1v"], e2u=gr["e2u"])

with test(*[f"datakit._source.Source.{m}" for m in ("__init__", "files", "read", "stream", "groups", "mesh", "grid", "vertical", "coords", "depth", "time_hours", "snapshot")], "datakit._source.source", "datakit._source.derived", "datakit._write.write_field", "datakit._write.provenance", "datakit._write.history", "preprocessing.baroclinic.split", "orcakit.grid_c.vertical_velocity", "datakit._source.Source.point_mask", "datakit._source.Source.point_coords", "orcakit.paths.get"):
    from orcakit import paths as PA
    toml = os.path.join(TMP, "paths.toml")
    with open(toml, "w") as t_: t_.write('one = "~/x"\n')
    saved = os.environ.get("LU_PATHS"); os.environ["LU_PATHS"] = toml
    yes("location read, with ~ expanded", PA.get("one") == os.path.expanduser("~/x"))
    yes("unset location gives a placeholder that names it", "two" in PA.get("two") and "not set" in PA.get("two"))
    if saved is None: del os.environ["LU_PATHS"]
    else: os.environ["LU_PATHS"] = saved
    nz, ny, nx = 3, 12, 16; e3 = np.array([10., 20., 30.]); mesh = os.path.join(TMP, "stage0_mesh.nc")
    tm = np.ones((nz, ny, nx), "i1"); tm[:, 5, 6] = 0
    um = tm*np.roll(tm, -1, axis=2); vm = tm*np.roll(tm, -1, axis=1)
    with netCDF4.Dataset(mesh, "w") as nc:
        for d, s in (("t", 1), ("z", nz), ("y", ny), ("x", nx)): nc.createDimension(d, s)
        nc.createVariable("e3t_0", "f8", ("t", "z"))[:] = e3
        nc.createVariable("e3t_ps", "f8", ("t", "y", "x"))[:] = e3[-1]
        for n_, a in (("tmask", tm), ("umask", um), ("vmask", vm)): nc.createVariable(n_, "i1", ("t", "z", "y", "x"))[:] = a
        for n_ in ("gphit", "glamt", "gphiu", "glamu", "e1t", "e2t", "e1u", "e2u", "e1v", "e2v", "e1f", "e2f"): nc.createVariable(n_, "f8", ("t", "y", "x"))[:] = 1000.
    S = SRC.Source("fake", os.path.join(TMP, "stage0_raw"), [mesh], "fk", 86400.)
    e3u, e3v, u_m, v_m = S.vertical(np.float64)
    yes("masks returned as boolean", u_m.dtype == bool and v_m.dtype == bool)
    ok("e3u is e3t_0 on wet points", (e3u - e3[:, None, None])[:, 1:-2, 1:-2][u_m[:, 1:-2, 1:-2]], 1e-12)
    ok("e3v is e3t_0 on wet points", (e3v - e3[:, None, None])[:, 1:-2, 1:-2][v_m[:, 1:-2, 1:-2]], 1e-12)
    g_ = S.grid(); yes("grid names the boundary and the metrics", g_["boundary"] == "t-fold" and g_["e1u"].shape == (ny, nx) and g_["lat"].shape == (ny, nx))
    yes("mesh reads by name", S.mesh("e3t_0").shape == (nz,))
    try:
        SRC.Source("f", "", [mesh], "f", 1., boundary="closed").vertical(); yes("other boundaries refused", False)
    except NotImplementedError:
        yes("other boundaries refused", True)
    u = 0.1*np.arange(1., nz*ny*nx + 1).reshape(nz, ny, nx)/(nz*ny*nx); u[:, 5, 6] = np.nan
    bt, bc = BC.split(u, e3u, u_m)
    w = e3u*u_m; ok("baroclinic part has zero weighted depth mean", np.nansum(np.nan_to_num(bc)*w, axis=0), 1e-11)
    wet = u_m.all(axis=0); ok("the parts rebuild the field", (bc + bt[None] - u)[:, wet], 1e-12)
    ok("barotropic is the weighted mean, hand value", bt[0, 0] - np.sum(u[:, 0, 0]*e3)/e3.sum(), 1e-12)
    yes("land is NaN in both parts", np.isnan(bc[0, 5, 6]) and np.isnan(bt[5, 6]) and (np.isnan(bc) == ~u_m).all())
    attrs = WR.provenance(source="fake"); yes("provenance has commit, command, date and extras", all(k in attrs for k in ("git_commit", "command", "created", "source")))
    lat, lon = np.zeros((ny, nx)), np.zeros((ny, nx)); dep = np.array([5., 20., 45.]); root = S.root
    for i, date in enumerate(("2015-01-01", "2015-01-02")):
        for var, sign in (("u", 1.), ("v", -1.)):
            p = WR.write_field(root, var, date, sign*(i + 1)*u, lat, lon, 100. + i, "fk", dep, np.float64 if var == "v" else np.float32, attrs)
    yes("path follows the convention", p.endswith(os.path.join("vomecrty", "vomecrty_fk_2015-01-02.nc")) and not glob.glob(p + ".tmp*"))
    with netCDF4.Dataset(p) as nc:
        yes("file convention", nc["vomecrty"].dimensions == ("deptht", "y", "x") and nc["time_counter"].shape == () and np.isnan(nc["vomecrty"]._FillValue) and nc["vomecrty"].filters()["zlib"] and nc["vomecrty"].dtype == np.float64 and nc.source == "fake")
    bt_path = WR.write_field(os.path.join(TMP, "stage0_bt"), "v", "2015-01-01", bt, lat, lon, 100., "fk")
    with netCDF4.Dataset(bt_path) as nc: yes("2D field has no depth", nc["vomecrty"].dimensions == ("y", "x"))
    both = WR.write_field(os.path.join(TMP, "stage0_split"), "v", "2015-01-01", bc, lat, lon, 100., "fk", dep, np.float64, attrs, {"vobtcrty": bt})
    Sp = SRC.derived(os.path.join(TMP, "stage0_split"), S)
    yes("both parts share one file", Sp.files("vbt") == Sp.files("v") == [both])
    with netCDF4.Dataset(both) as nc: yes("barotropic part is 2D, baroclinic 3D, same type", nc["vobtcrty"].dimensions == ("y", "x") and nc["vomecrty"].dimensions == ("deptht", "y", "x") and nc["vobtcrty"].dtype == np.float64)
    ok("barotropic part reads back by common name", np.nan_to_num(Sp.read("vbt")[0] - np.float32(bt)), 1e-6)
    ok("baroclinic part reads back by common name", np.nan_to_num(Sp.read("v", level=None)[0] - np.float32(bc)), 1e-6)
    import _common as CM
    yes("resume accepts the same precision", not CM.incompatible(both, ("vomecrty", "vobtcrty"), np.float64))
    yes("resume refuses another precision", CM.incompatible(both, ("vomecrty", "vobtcrty"), np.float32))
    yes("resume refuses a file with one part", CM.incompatible(p, ("vomecrty", "vobtcrty"), np.float64))
    WV = lambda a, b, m: grid_c.vertical_velocity(a, b, exchange=orca.halo, **m)
    yes("point mask by name", S.point_mask("U").dtype == bool)
    pc = S.point_coords("U"); yes("point coordinates from the mesh", len(pc) == 2 and pc[0].shape == (ny, nx))
    gr = S.grid(); M_ = dict(e3u=e3u, e3v=e3v, umask=np.ones_like(u_m), vmask=np.ones_like(v_m), tmask=np.ones_like(u_m), e1t=gr["e1t"], e2t=gr["e2t"], e1v=gr["e1v"], e2u=gr["e2u"])
    M_["e3u"] = M_["e3v"] = e3[:, None, None]*np.ones((nz, ny, nx))
    w_ = WV(np.full((nz, ny, nx), 0.3), np.full((nz, ny, nx), 0.0), M_)
    ok("uniform flow in a periodic channel has no w", w_[:, 1:, 1:-1], 1e-12)
    jj_ = np.arange(ny)[None, :, None]*np.ones((nz, ny, nx)); w_ = WV(np.zeros((nz, ny, nx)), 1e-3*jj_, M_)
    ok("constant divergence gives w by hand, top of the column", w_[0, 3:-3, 3:-3] + 1e-6*e3[:-1].sum(), 1e-12)
    yes("w is NaN on land", np.isnan(WV(np.zeros((nz, ny, nx)), np.zeros((nz, ny, nx)), {**M_, "tmask": tm.astype(bool)})[0, 5, 6]))
    dep_ = WR.write_field(os.path.join(TMP, "stage0_w"), "w", "2015-01-01", w_, lat, lon, 100., "fk", dep, depth_name="depthw")
    with netCDF4.Dataset(dep_) as nc: yes("w files use W levels", nc["vovecrtz"].dimensions == ("depthw", "y", "x"))
    raw_ = os.path.join(TMP, "raw_hist.nc")
    with netCDF4.Dataset(raw_, "w") as nc: nc.history = "made upstream"
    h1 = WR.provenance("PP1 baroclinic: split", raw_)["history"]
    yes("first step: its line, then the raw file and its own history", h1.splitlines()[0].endswith(" | " + os.path.basename(sys.argv[0]) + " " + " ".join(sys.argv[1:])) and "PP1 baroclinic: split" in h1.splitlines()[0] and h1.splitlines()[1:] == ["source file: raw_hist.nc", "made upstream"])
    mid_ = WR.write_field(os.path.join(TMP, "hist"), "u", "2015-01-01", bt, lat, lon, 100., "fk", attrs=WR.provenance("PP1 baroclinic: split", raw_))
    h2 = WR.provenance("PP4 spatial_filter: low", mid_)["history"].splitlines()
    yes("second step goes on top of the first, newest first", "PP4" in h2[0] and "PP1" in h2[1] and h2[2] == "source file: raw_hist.nc")
    yes("no git commit in history", all("git" not in l for l in h2))
    h3 = WR.provenance("PP7 running: cov", {"u": mid_, "v": raw_})["history"].splitlines()
    yes("two inputs keep both histories, indented", h3[1] == "inputs: u" and h3[2].startswith("  ") and "inputs: v" in h3 and "  source file: raw_hist.nc" in h3)
    yes("without a step, no history", "history" not in WR.provenance(source="x"))
    yes("output path", BC.output_path("d", "vomecrty", "fk", "1993-01") == os.path.join("d", "split", "vomecrty", "vomecrty_fk_1993-01.nc"))
    D = SRC.derived(root, S); yes("derived keeps the grid, tag and step", D.mesh_files == [mesh] and D.tag == "fk" and D.dt == 86400. and D.name == "stage0_raw")
    yes("common and source names find the same files", D.files("u") == D.files("vozocrtx") and len(D.files("u", "2015-01-02")) == 1)
    r = D.read("u", level=None); ok("read back, single precision", np.nan_to_num(r[1] - np.float32(2*u)), 2e-6); yes("read shape", r.shape == (2, nz, ny, nx))
    ok("double precision survives the round trip", np.nan_to_num(D.snapshot(D.files("v")[0], "v", np.float64) + u), 1e-14)
    got = list(D.stream("u", "v", level=1)); yes("stream by common names", [g[0] for g in got] == ["2015-01-01", "2015-01-02"] and got[0][1].shape == (ny, nx))
    os.remove(D.files("v", "2015-01-02")[0]); gr, miss = D.groups("u", "v"); yes("groups keeps common dates and names the others", [g[0] for g in gr] == ["2015-01-01"] and miss == ["2015-01-02"])
    f0 = D.files("u")[0]; ok("time kept", D.time_hours(f0) - 100., 1e-9); ok("depth kept", D.depth(f0) - dep, 1e-5); yes("coordinates kept", D.coords(f0)[0].shape == (ny, nx))
    other = os.path.join(TMP, "stage0_time.nc")
    with netCDF4.Dataset(other, "w") as nc:
        nc.createDimension("time_counter", 1); t = nc.createVariable("time_counter", "f8", ("time_counter",)); t.units, t.calendar = "seconds since 1950-01-02", "gregorian"; t[:] = 3600.
    ok("other time units convert: one day and one hour", D.time_hours(other) - 25., 1e-9)

py-kits › datakit › _source › Source.vertical

Source.vertical

Cell thicknesses and wet masks at U and V points.

Description

Depth means and transports need the thickness of every cell, including the partial cells at the sea floor. These are the mesh's thicknesses, fixed in time, so they do not follow the free surface.

Raises NotImplementedError for a north boundary other than a T-point fold.

$$e_{3u},\ e_{3v} = \text{orca.e3uv\_from\_partial\_steps}(e_{3t}^0,\ e_{3t}^{ps},\ t, u, v)$$

Syntax

e3u, e3v, umask, vmask = Source.vertical()e3u, e3v, umask, vmask = Source.vertical(dtype=np.float32)

Input Arguments

dtype — dtype — default np.float32
Type of the thicknesses

Output Arguments

e3u — float
(nz, ny, nx) U-cell thicknesses, in metres, 0 on land
e3v — float
(nz, ny, nx) V-cell thicknesses, in metres, 0 on land
umask — bool
(nz, ny, nx) U-point wet mask
vmask — bool
(nz, ny, nx) V-point wet mask

Example

e3u, e3v, u_m, v_m = S.vertical(np.float64)
SRC.Source("f", "", [mesh], "f", 1., boundary="closed").vertical(); yes("other boundaries refused", False)

    S = SRC.Source("fake", os.path.join(TMP, "stage0_raw"), [mesh], "fk", 86400.)

    ok("e3v is e3t_0 on wet points", (e3v - e3[:, None, None])[:, 1:-2, 1:-2][v_m[:, 1:-2, 1:-2]], 1e-12)

    try:

    wet = u_m.all(axis=0); ok("the parts rebuild the field", (bc + bt[None] - u)[:, wet], 1e-12)
    ok("barotropic is the weighted mean, hand value", bt[0, 0] - np.sum(u[:, 0, 0]*e3)/e3.sum(), 1e-12)
    yes("land is NaN in both parts", np.isnan(bc[0, 5, 6]) and np.isnan(bt[5, 6]) and (np.isnan(bc) == ~u_m).all())

    lat, lon = np.zeros((ny, nx)), np.zeros((ny, nx)); dep = np.array([5., 20., 45.]); root = S.root

    h3 = WR.provenance("PP7 running: cov", {"u": mid_, "v": raw_})["history"].splitlines()
    yes("two inputs keep both histories, indented", h3[1] == "inputs: u" and h3[2].startswith("  ") and "inputs: v" in h3 and "  source file: raw_hist.nc" in h3)
    yes("without a step, no history", "history" not in WR.provenance(source="x"))

    got = list(D.stream("u", "v", level=1)); yes("stream by common names", [g[0] for g in got] == ["2015-01-01", "2015-01-02"] and got[0][1].shape == (ny, nx))

orcakit.orca.e3uv_from_partial_steps | Source.point_mask

py-kits › datakit › _source › Source.point_coords

Source.point_coords

Latitude and longitude of one kind of C-grid point, from the mesh.

Description

U and V points lie half a cell from the T points. Files often store the coordinates of one point type only; these are the right ones for a field at any point.

$$(\varphi_p,\ \lambda_p) = (\text{gphi}p,\ \text{glam}p)$$

Syntax

lat, lon = Source.point_coords(point)

Input Arguments

point — str
'T', 'U', 'V' or 'F'

Output Arguments

lat — float
(ny, nx) latitude, in degrees
lon — float
(ny, nx) longitude, in degrees

Example

pc = S.point_coords("U"); yes("point coordinates from the mesh", len(pc) == 2 and pc[0].shape == (ny, nx))

    r = D.read("u", level=None); ok("read back, single precision", np.nan_to_num(r[1] - np.float32(2*u)), 2e-6); yes("read shape", r.shape == (2, nz, ny, nx))
    ok("double precision survives the round trip", np.nan_to_num(D.snapshot(D.files("v")[0], "v", np.float64) + u), 1e-14)
    got = list(D.stream("u", "v", level=1)); yes("stream by common names", [g[0] for g in got] == ["2015-01-01", "2015-01-02"] and got[0][1].shape == (ny, nx))
    os.remove(D.files("v", "2015-01-02")[0]); gr, miss = D.groups("u", "v"); yes("groups keeps common dates and names the others", [g[0] for g in gr] == ["2015-01-01"] and miss == ["2015-01-02"])
    f0 = D.files("u")[0]; ok("time kept", D.time_hours(f0) - 100., 1e-9); ok("depth kept", D.depth(f0) - dep, 1e-5); yes("coordinates kept", D.coords(f0)[0].shape == (ny, nx))
    other = os.path.join(TMP, "stage0_time.nc")
    with netCDF4.Dataset(other, "w") as nc:
        nc.createDimension("time_counter", 1); t = nc.createVariable("time_counter", "f8", ("time_counter",)); t.units, t.calendar = "seconds since 1950-01-02", "gregorian"; t[:] = 3600.
    ok("other time units convert: one day and one hour", D.time_hours(other) - 25., 1e-9)
    for name_ in ("glorys04", "glorys12", "cmems"): yes(f"source finds {name_}", SRC.source(name_).name == name_)

py-kits › datakit › _source › Source.coords

Source.coords

Nav_lat and nav_lon as stored in one file.

Description

They may belong to another point than the file's field. point_coords gives those of a chosen point.

$$(\varphi, \lambda) = (\text{nav\_lat},\ \text{nav\_lon})$$

Syntax

lat, lon = Source.coords(path)

Input Arguments

path — str
NetCDF file

Output Arguments

lat — float
(ny, nx) nav_lat
lon — float
(ny, nx) nav_lon

Example

f0 = D.files("u")[0]; ok("time kept", D.time_hours(f0) - 100., 1e-9); ok("depth kept", D.depth(f0) - dep, 1e-5); yes("coordinates kept", D.coords(f0)[0].shape == (ny, nx))
Whole test
with test(*[f"datakit._source.Source.{m}" for m in ("__init__", "files", "read", "stream", "groups", "mesh", "grid", "vertical", "coords", "depth", "time_hours", "snapshot")], "datakit._source.source", "datakit._source.derived", "datakit._write.write_field", "datakit._write.provenance", "datakit._write.history", "preprocessing.baroclinic.split", "orcakit.grid_c.vertical_velocity", "datakit._source.Source.point_mask", "datakit._source.Source.point_coords", "orcakit.paths.get"):
    from orcakit import paths as PA
    toml = os.path.join(TMP, "paths.toml")
    with open(toml, "w") as t_: t_.write('one = "~/x"\n')
    saved = os.environ.get("LU_PATHS"); os.environ["LU_PATHS"] = toml
    yes("location read, with ~ expanded", PA.get("one") == os.path.expanduser("~/x"))
    yes("unset location gives a placeholder that names it", "two" in PA.get("two") and "not set" in PA.get("two"))
    if saved is None: del os.environ["LU_PATHS"]
    else: os.environ["LU_PATHS"] = saved
    nz, ny, nx = 3, 12, 16; e3 = np.array([10., 20., 30.]); mesh = os.path.join(TMP, "stage0_mesh.nc")
    tm = np.ones((nz, ny, nx), "i1"); tm[:, 5, 6] = 0
    um = tm*np.roll(tm, -1, axis=2); vm = tm*np.roll(tm, -1, axis=1)
    with netCDF4.Dataset(mesh, "w") as nc:
        for d, s in (("t", 1), ("z", nz), ("y", ny), ("x", nx)): nc.createDimension(d, s)
        nc.createVariable("e3t_0", "f8", ("t", "z"))[:] = e3
        nc.createVariable("e3t_ps", "f8", ("t", "y", "x"))[:] = e3[-1]
        for n_, a in (("tmask", tm), ("umask", um), ("vmask", vm)): nc.createVariable(n_, "i1", ("t", "z", "y", "x"))[:] = a
        for n_ in ("gphit", "glamt", "gphiu", "glamu", "e1t", "e2t", "e1u", "e2u", "e1v", "e2v", "e1f", "e2f"): nc.createVariable(n_, "f8", ("t", "y", "x"))[:] = 1000.
    S = SRC.Source("fake", os.path.join(TMP, "stage0_raw"), [mesh], "fk", 86400.)
    e3u, e3v, u_m, v_m = S.vertical(np.float64)
    yes("masks returned as boolean", u_m.dtype == bool and v_m.dtype == bool)
    ok("e3u is e3t_0 on wet points", (e3u - e3[:, None, None])[:, 1:-2, 1:-2][u_m[:, 1:-2, 1:-2]], 1e-12)
    ok("e3v is e3t_0 on wet points", (e3v - e3[:, None, None])[:, 1:-2, 1:-2][v_m[:, 1:-2, 1:-2]], 1e-12)
    g_ = S.grid(); yes("grid names the boundary and the metrics", g_["boundary"] == "t-fold" and g_["e1u"].shape == (ny, nx) and g_["lat"].shape == (ny, nx))
    yes("mesh reads by name", S.mesh("e3t_0").shape == (nz,))
    try:
        SRC.Source("f", "", [mesh], "f", 1., boundary="closed").vertical(); yes("other boundaries refused", False)
    except NotImplementedError:
        yes("other boundaries refused", True)
    u = 0.1*np.arange(1., nz*ny*nx + 1).reshape(nz, ny, nx)/(nz*ny*nx); u[:, 5, 6] = np.nan
    bt, bc = BC.split(u, e3u, u_m)
    w = e3u*u_m; ok("baroclinic part has zero weighted depth mean", np.nansum(np.nan_to_num(bc)*w, axis=0), 1e-11)
    wet = u_m.all(axis=0); ok("the parts rebuild the field", (bc + bt[None] - u)[:, wet], 1e-12)
    ok("barotropic is the weighted mean, hand value", bt[0, 0] - np.sum(u[:, 0, 0]*e3)/e3.sum(), 1e-12)
    yes("land is NaN in both parts", np.isnan(bc[0, 5, 6]) and np.isnan(bt[5, 6]) and (np.isnan(bc) == ~u_m).all())
    attrs = WR.provenance(source="fake"); yes("provenance has commit, command, date and extras", all(k in attrs for k in ("git_commit", "command", "created", "source")))
    lat, lon = np.zeros((ny, nx)), np.zeros((ny, nx)); dep = np.array([5., 20., 45.]); root = S.root
    for i, date in enumerate(("2015-01-01", "2015-01-02")):
        for var, sign in (("u", 1.), ("v", -1.)):
            p = WR.write_field(root, var, date, sign*(i + 1)*u, lat, lon, 100. + i, "fk", dep, np.float64 if var == "v" else np.float32, attrs)
    yes("path follows the convention", p.endswith(os.path.join("vomecrty", "vomecrty_fk_2015-01-02.nc")) and not glob.glob(p + ".tmp*"))
    with netCDF4.Dataset(p) as nc:
        yes("file convention", nc["vomecrty"].dimensions == ("deptht", "y", "x") and nc["time_counter"].shape == () and np.isnan(nc["vomecrty"]._FillValue) and nc["vomecrty"].filters()["zlib"] and nc["vomecrty"].dtype == np.float64 and nc.source == "fake")
    bt_path = WR.write_field(os.path.join(TMP, "stage0_bt"), "v", "2015-01-01", bt, lat, lon, 100., "fk")
    with netCDF4.Dataset(bt_path) as nc: yes("2D field has no depth", nc["vomecrty"].dimensions == ("y", "x"))
    both = WR.write_field(os.path.join(TMP, "stage0_split"), "v", "2015-01-01", bc, lat, lon, 100., "fk", dep, np.float64, attrs, {"vobtcrty": bt})
    Sp = SRC.derived(os.path.join(TMP, "stage0_split"), S)
    yes("both parts share one file", Sp.files("vbt") == Sp.files("v") == [both])
    with netCDF4.Dataset(both) as nc: yes("barotropic part is 2D, baroclinic 3D, same type", nc["vobtcrty"].dimensions == ("y", "x") and nc["vomecrty"].dimensions == ("deptht", "y", "x") and nc["vobtcrty"].dtype == np.float64)
    ok("barotropic part reads back by common name", np.nan_to_num(Sp.read("vbt")[0] - np.float32(bt)), 1e-6)
    ok("baroclinic part reads back by common name", np.nan_to_num(Sp.read("v", level=None)[0] - np.float32(bc)), 1e-6)
    import _common as CM
    yes("resume accepts the same precision", not CM.incompatible(both, ("vomecrty", "vobtcrty"), np.float64))
    yes("resume refuses another precision", CM.incompatible(both, ("vomecrty", "vobtcrty"), np.float32))
    yes("resume refuses a file with one part", CM.incompatible(p, ("vomecrty", "vobtcrty"), np.float64))
    WV = lambda a, b, m: grid_c.vertical_velocity(a, b, exchange=orca.halo, **m)
    yes("point mask by name", S.point_mask("U").dtype == bool)
    pc = S.point_coords("U"); yes("point coordinates from the mesh", len(pc) == 2 and pc[0].shape == (ny, nx))
    gr = S.grid(); M_ = dict(e3u=e3u, e3v=e3v, umask=np.ones_like(u_m), vmask=np.ones_like(v_m), tmask=np.ones_like(u_m), e1t=gr["e1t"], e2t=gr["e2t"], e1v=gr["e1v"], e2u=gr["e2u"])
    M_["e3u"] = M_["e3v"] = e3[:, None, None]*np.ones((nz, ny, nx))
    w_ = WV(np.full((nz, ny, nx), 0.3), np.full((nz, ny, nx), 0.0), M_)
    ok("uniform flow in a periodic channel has no w", w_[:, 1:, 1:-1], 1e-12)
    jj_ = np.arange(ny)[None, :, None]*np.ones((nz, ny, nx)); w_ = WV(np.zeros((nz, ny, nx)), 1e-3*jj_, M_)
    ok("constant divergence gives w by hand, top of the column", w_[0, 3:-3, 3:-3] + 1e-6*e3[:-1].sum(), 1e-12)
    yes("w is NaN on land", np.isnan(WV(np.zeros((nz, ny, nx)), np.zeros((nz, ny, nx)), {**M_, "tmask": tm.astype(bool)})[0, 5, 6]))
    dep_ = WR.write_field(os.path.join(TMP, "stage0_w"), "w", "2015-01-01", w_, lat, lon, 100., "fk", dep, depth_name="depthw")
    with netCDF4.Dataset(dep_) as nc: yes("w files use W levels", nc["vovecrtz"].dimensions == ("depthw", "y", "x"))
    raw_ = os.path.join(TMP, "raw_hist.nc")
    with netCDF4.Dataset(raw_, "w") as nc: nc.history = "made upstream"
    h1 = WR.provenance("PP1 baroclinic: split", raw_)["history"]
    yes("first step: its line, then the raw file and its own history", h1.splitlines()[0].endswith(" | " + os.path.basename(sys.argv[0]) + " " + " ".join(sys.argv[1:])) and "PP1 baroclinic: split" in h1.splitlines()[0] and h1.splitlines()[1:] == ["source file: raw_hist.nc", "made upstream"])
    mid_ = WR.write_field(os.path.join(TMP, "hist"), "u", "2015-01-01", bt, lat, lon, 100., "fk", attrs=WR.provenance("PP1 baroclinic: split", raw_))
    h2 = WR.provenance("PP4 spatial_filter: low", mid_)["history"].splitlines()
    yes("second step goes on top of the first, newest first", "PP4" in h2[0] and "PP1" in h2[1] and h2[2] == "source file: raw_hist.nc")
    yes("no git commit in history", all("git" not in l for l in h2))
    h3 = WR.provenance("PP7 running: cov", {"u": mid_, "v": raw_})["history"].splitlines()
    yes("two inputs keep both histories, indented", h3[1] == "inputs: u" and h3[2].startswith("  ") and "inputs: v" in h3 and "  source file: raw_hist.nc" in h3)
    yes("without a step, no history", "history" not in WR.provenance(source="x"))
    yes("output path", BC.output_path("d", "vomecrty", "fk", "1993-01") == os.path.join("d", "split", "vomecrty", "vomecrty_fk_1993-01.nc"))
    D = SRC.derived(root, S); yes("derived keeps the grid, tag and step", D.mesh_files == [mesh] and D.tag == "fk" and D.dt == 86400. and D.name == "stage0_raw")
    yes("common and source names find the same files", D.files("u") == D.files("vozocrtx") and len(D.files("u", "2015-01-02")) == 1)
    r = D.read("u", level=None); ok("read back, single precision", np.nan_to_num(r[1] - np.float32(2*u)), 2e-6); yes("read shape", r.shape == (2, nz, ny, nx))
    ok("double precision survives the round trip", np.nan_to_num(D.snapshot(D.files("v")[0], "v", np.float64) + u), 1e-14)
    got = list(D.stream("u", "v", level=1)); yes("stream by common names", [g[0] for g in got] == ["2015-01-01", "2015-01-02"] and got[0][1].shape == (ny, nx))
    os.remove(D.files("v", "2015-01-02")[0]); gr, miss = D.groups("u", "v"); yes("groups keeps common dates and names the others", [g[0] for g in gr] == ["2015-01-01"] and miss == ["2015-01-02"])
    f0 = D.files("u")[0]; ok("time kept", D.time_hours(f0) - 100., 1e-9); ok("depth kept", D.depth(f0) - dep, 1e-5); yes("coordinates kept", D.coords(f0)[0].shape == (ny, nx))
    other = os.path.join(TMP, "stage0_time.nc")
    with netCDF4.Dataset(other, "w") as nc:
        nc.createDimension("time_counter", 1); t = nc.createVariable("time_counter", "f8", ("time_counter",)); t.units, t.calendar = "seconds since 1950-01-02", "gregorian"; t[:] = 3600.
    ok("other time units convert: one day and one hour", D.time_hours(other) - 25., 1e-9)
    for name_ in ("glorys04", "glorys12", "cmems"): yes(f"source finds {name_}", SRC.source(name_).name == name_)

The depth levels of one file.

See also

Source.snapshot

py-kits › datakit › _source › Source.time_hours

Source.time_hours

The time of one file, in hours since 1950-01-01.

Description

Datasets count time from different origins and in different units. Converting all of them to one axis lets files from different sources be compared and written alike.

$$t = \text{date2num}(\text{num2date}(t_{\text{file}}),\ \text{hours since 1950-01-01})$$

Syntax

hours = Source.time_hours(path)

Input Arguments

path — str
NetCDF file

Output Arguments

hours — float
Time of its first snapshot

Example

f0 = D.files("u")[0]; ok("time kept", D.time_hours(f0) - 100., 1e-9); ok("depth kept", D.depth(f0) - dep, 1e-5); yes("coordinates kept", D.coords(f0)[0].shape == (ny, nx))
ok("other time units convert: one day and one hour", D.time_hours(other) - 25., 1e-9)

Source.snapshot

All levels of one variable from one file.

Description

Syntax
